import sys
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext, ROUND_DOWN

# Wide precision for all decimal arithmetic
getcontext().prec = 40

def accept_numeric(digits: int, scale: int = 0) -> Decimal:
    """Read one line, apply COBOL ACCEPT rules for numeric field:
    - truncate line on the RIGHT to field width (digits)
    - take leading digit prefix only
    - empty or no leading digits -> 0
    - return as Decimal (scale handled by caller if needed)"""
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:
        line = ""
    else:
        line = line.rstrip('\n')          # strip only trailing newline
    truncated = line[:digits]             # rule 3b: over-long line truncates on RIGHT
    num_str = ""
    for ch in truncated:                  # rule 3c: stop at first non-digit
        if ch.isdigit():
            num_str += ch
        else:
            break
    value = int(num_str) if num_str else 0
    return Decimal(value)                 # scale=0 for WS-CODE

def accept_alpha(width: int) -> str:
    """Read one line, apply COBOL ACCEPT rules for alphanumeric field:
    - left-justify, space-pad or truncate on RIGHT to exact width"""
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:
        line = ""
    else:
        line = line.rstrip('\n')
    if len(line) >= width:
        return line[:width]
    return line.ljust(width)

def format_fee(fee: Decimal) -> str:
    """Format a Decimal fee into PIC Z(3)9.99 (7 characters):
    - quantize to 2dp with truncation (ROUND_DOWN)
    - suppress leading zeros in first 3 integer positions (Z)
    - 4th integer position never suppressed (9)
    - high-order truncation via modulo 10000 (rule 3a)"""
    fee = fee.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_DOWN)
    if fee < 0:
        fee = -fee
    total_cents = int((fee * 100).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_DOWN))
    int_dollars = (total_cents // 100) % 10000   # high-order truncation
    cents = total_cents % 100
    int_str = f"{int_dollars:04d}"               # 4-digit zero-padded
    # Z(3) suppression on first 3 digits
    suppressed = []
    suppress_active = True
    for ch in int_str[:3]:
        if suppress_active and ch == '0':
            suppressed.append(' ')
        else:
            suppress_active = False
            suppressed.append(ch)
    fourth = int_str[3]                          # 9 position
    frac_str = f"{cents:02d}"
    return ''.join(suppressed) + fourth + '.' + frac_str

def main() -> None:
    # ACCEPT WS-CODE (PIC 9(2))
    ws_code = accept_numeric(2, 0)
    # ACCEPT WS-REGION (PIC X)
    ws_region = accept_alpha(1)

    code = int(ws_code)        # 0-99
    region = ws_region         # single character

    # EVALUATE WS-CODE ALSO WS-REGION (first-match-wins, overlapping order-dependent)
    ws_fee = Decimal('0')
    ws_label = " " * 10

    if 1 <= code <= 9 and region == 'N':
        ws_fee = Decimal('10.50')
        ws_label = "NORTH-LOW"
    elif 1 <= code <= 9:                   # ALSO ANY
        ws_fee = Decimal('12.75')
        ws_label = "ANY-LOW"
    elif 10 <= code <= 49 and region == 'N':
        ws_fee = Decimal('22.00')
        ws_label = "NORTH-MID"
    elif region == 'S':                    # WHEN ANY ALSO "S" (catches all S, makes next branch dead)
        ws_fee = Decimal('31.25')
        ws_label = "SOUTH-ALL"
    elif 10 <= code <= 49 and region == 'S':  # DEAD CODE - never reached
        ws_fee = Decimal('99.99')
        ws_label = "DEAD-CODE"
    else:                                  # WHEN OTHER
        ws_fee = Decimal('45.00')
        ws_label = "FALLBACK"

    # MOVE WS-FEE TO WS-FEE-OUT (PIC Z(3)9.99)
    ws_fee_out = format_fee(ws_fee)

    # DISPLAY "LABEL " WS-LABEL (PIC X(10) left-justified space-padded)
    label_out = ws_label.ljust(10)[:10]
    print("LABEL " + label_out)

    # DISPLAY "FEE   " WS-FEE-OUT
    print("FEE   " + ws_fee_out)

    # STOP RUN
    sys.exit(0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
